svg.aria-label: Why fixed data leave multiple answers. The upper row shows value tables and original coverage. The bottom compares Q, CQL, and greedy BC trained on the same 200 records in two worlds differing only in the unrecorded action reward. The coverage-augmented Q uses ten additional −2 transitions and appears only above. The shared color scale runs from −4 to 4.
